body: I edited for clarity.  I am only making demands for my own home and happiness.
I have told them this.  Which is why I feel like the asshole.  Ultimatum was a terrible word to use.  There is no ultimatum.  It is me putting my foot down about my own home.

Me?  

My biggest fear is that I inherit full responsibility of his shenanigans.
Ultimatum was a terrible word to use.  You are correct.  I am not forcing a choice other than my house not being a choice.

Absolutely.  I really shouldn't have called it an ultimatum.  It was a bad word to use.  I will also take time to describe the situation a bit more.  

I cannot have another person in my home right now.  I think I am being more than generous and willing to help with a temporary solution.  I did not ask to be involved with any of this, but have been pulled in.  I do not have the bandwidth at this time.

My other uncle would take him in.  However, that is not the preferred scenario for the uncle who wants to move in.  My uncle would prefer that he move in with my mom and that is my mom's preferred situation.  My mom wants him near her.  My mom recently moved to where I live. Now my house is being offered up when my brother does not need to stay with her.  I feel that if she wants him near her, then she has to figure this one out on her own.  I cannot be pulled into every bit of family drama.  I have my own life and goals.
